purpose: Document first-party city-specific registry evidence and bounded anonymous parcel geometry/schema review.
assessment: The official city-map article links a RAR5 archive that an ordinary anonymous HTTPS GET fetched successfully (HTTP 200; 20,223,190 bytes). Its non-extracting archive manifest contains exactly three static JPEG map images (traffic, administrative, and general maps; all dated 2021-11-19), with no GIS/vector files or parcel-feature schema. The city registration guide limits record queries to eligible parties and application channels; no record query was made. No anonymous parcel geometry was returned or retained.
registryAssessment: The official Ganzhou Natural Resources Bureau names the Ganzhou Real Estate Registration Center as the receiving unit and provides local registration-record channels; this confirms city-specific registry operations, not public geometry access.

Bureau article links a downloadable 2021 city-map RAR5 archive; its fetched contents are three static JPEG map products, not a feature service or vector parcel dataset.
Official service guide names Ganzhou Real Estate Registration Center and limits file/record queries to rights holders, interested parties, or authorized bodies; applications and proof are required.
